title: Lokomotiv 2020 conquer Division A title
description: FINALLokomotiv 2020 - NSA 75-65 Lokomotiv 2020 overcame NSA to conquer Division A title. Lokomotiv 2020 forced 23 NSA turnovers. The former international forward Stanislav Slaveykov (198-86) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 29 points and 12 rebounds for the winners and swingman Samuel Francis (192-92, college: St.Joseph, IN) chipped in 17 points and 7 rebounds. At the losing side center Dragomir Enchev (206-98) responded with 9 points and 12 rebounds and guard Martin Petrov (182-1) scored 14 points and 4 assists. Four NSA players scored in double figures.
